title: Two-part snap-fit enclosure (FDM)
prompt: Model a two-part snap-fit enclosure for FDM: base box 60x40x25 mm outer, 2 mm walls, and a lid that closes with two cantilever snap-fits on the long sides. Parts must be separate solids side by side on the plate, with 0.25 mm clearance on the lid lip. Drive wall thickness (WallT=2), clearance (Clearance=0.25) and outer size from a Parameters spreadsheet.

dimensions.name: outer_length
dimensions.comment: floor, not a target: the overall bbox spans both parts, so the exact X extent is a layout choice, not a dimension
